Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting to signed-in account  **What I found from a read-only audit (no code changed):**  - Backend (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`) correctly scopes every read/write to `user_id` derived from the session cookie (`arca_session` → `getSession()` → `X-User-Id`).
